name: 98290 · Snohomish, WA
findings: ZIP 98290 (Snohomish) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98290 (Snohomish) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
